text:
The noble gases are placed in Group VIII of the Periodic Table.
Which statement explains why they are unreactive?
A
They have eight electrons in their outer shell.
B
They have a full outer shell of electrons.
C
They have even numbers of neutrons.
D
They have even numbers of protons.

options.label: A
options.text: They have eight electrons in their outer shell.

options.label: B
options.text: They have a full outer shell of electrons.

options.label: C
options.text: They have even numbers of neutrons.

options.label: D
options.text: They have even numbers of protons.
